text.en: Approval of the NSP 2023-2028. The NSP 2023-2028 is hereby

Adoption and Implementation of the NSP 2023-2028. All NGAs and
instrumentalities, including GOCCs, and LGUs shall adopt the NSP 2023-2028 in the
formulation and implementation of their security-related strategies and programs.
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

Support from All Sectors. All GAs and instrumentalities, including
GOCCs, and LGUs shall encourage all sectors of society to participate in the
implementation of the NSP 2023-2028 towards achieving a holistic approach to addressing
national security issues and priorities, consistent with their mandates, in their respective
areas of expertise or jurisdiction.

Technical Assistance. Whenever necessary, the National Security
Council (NSC) Secretariat shall provide technical assistance and support to agencies and
other government entities in the formulation of policies and strategies affecting national

Reporting and Monitoring. The National Security Adviser (NSA) shall
conduct a periodic assessment and submit reports to the President and the NSC on the
implementation of the NSP 2023-2028, and coordinate with the various GAs and
instrumentalities, GOCCs, and LGUs in the preparation thereot.
For this purpose, the NSC, through the NSA, shall monitor the implementation of the
NSP 2023-2028, and upon consultation with and concurrence of relevant government
agencies, GOCCs, and LGUs, shall propose memoranda, circulars and other orders related
to the implementation thereof, for the approval of the President.

Funding. The funds necessary for the implementation of this Order shall
be charged against current and available appropriations of concerned agencies, subject to
pertinent budgeting, accounting, and auditing laws, rules and regulations. Thereafter, the
funding requirements for succeeding years shall be included in the annual General
Appropriations Act, subject to the usual budget preparation process.

Separability. If any part or provision of this Order shall be held invalid or
unconstitutional, the provisions not affected thereby shall remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. All orders, rules and regulations, and other issuances or parts
thereof which are inconsistent with the provisions of this Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon publication in
the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 10th
